---
title: "Position Letters"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Every position letter the lobby corps has filed, newest first. Linked from
the Lobbyists page and the home page's Letters Desk (not the navbar).

```{r letters-summary}
#| results: asis
source("scripts/shared.R")

letters <- scan_letters()
bills   <- load_bills()

n_all     <- nrow(letters)
n_support <- if (n_all > 0) sum(letters$position %in% c("Support", "Support If Amended")) else 0
n_oppose  <- if (n_all > 0) sum(letters$position %in% c("Oppose", "Oppose Unless Amended")) else 0
n_orgs    <- if (n_all > 0) length(unique(letters$org_code)) else 0
n_bills   <- if (n_all > 0) length(unique(letters$bill_number)) else 0

cat('<div class="stat-strip">',
    stat_html("Letters Filed", n_all, sprintf("by %d organization%s", n_orgs, ifelse(n_orgs == 1, "", "s"))),
    stat_html("In Support", n_support, "incl. support if amended"),
    stat_html("In Opposition", n_oppose, "incl. oppose unless amended"),
    stat_html("Bills Addressed", n_bills),
    '</div>', sep = "\n")
```

```{r letters-table}
library(reactable)
if (n_all == 0) {
  htmltools::p(class = "muted", "No position letters filed yet.")
} else {
  senators <- load_senators()
  tbl <- letters |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_number, title, url_slug, name, name_join), by = "bill_number") |>
    left_join(senators |> select(name_join, District), by = "name_join") |>
    arrange_letters() |>
    transmute(Filed = filed, Lobby, org_code, Position = position,
              bill_number, url_slug, Subject = title, Author = name, District, filename) |>
    as.data.frame()

  legsim_table(
    tbl,
    page_size = 25,
    columns = list(
      Filed = colDef(format = LEGSIM_DATE, width = 100),
      Lobby = colDef(name = "Organization", minWidth = 170,
                     cell = link_cell("", file.path(LOBBY_PAGES_DIR, paste0(tbl$org_code, ".html")))),
      org_code = colDef(show = FALSE),
      Position = colDef(width = 185, cell = function(value) {
        cls <- if (value == "Support") "s-pass"
               else if (value == "Oppose") "s-fail"
               else "s-active"
        htmltools::tagList(htmltools::span(class = paste("status-dot", cls)), " ", value)
      }),
      bill_number = colDef(name = "Bill", width = 85,
                           cell = link_cell("SB-", ifelse(is.na(tbl$url_slug), NA,
                                                          file.path(BILL_PAGES_DIR, paste0(tbl$url_slug, ".html"))))),
      url_slug = colDef(show = FALSE),
      Subject = colDef(minWidth = 180),
      Author = colDef(minWidth = 120, cell = link_cell("", senator_url(tbl$District))),
      District = colDef(show = FALSE),
      filename = colDef(name = "Letter", sortable = FALSE, width = 100,
                        cell = function(value) htmltools::tags$a(href = file.path(LETTERS_DIR, value), "View letter"))
    )
  )
}
```
